item.title: Basement Jaxx: A Different Kind of Dance Act • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Basement Jaxx is a British electronic duo known for blending house, funk, soul, and global sounds into energetic tracks.

item.title: DJ Tonka: Clean Grooves from the Heart of Club Culture • Lounge Avenue
item.description: DJ Tonka shaped late 90s club culture with clean, disciplined tracks built for DJs, long nights, and timeless European dancefloors.

item.title: Modjo: One Hit, One Era, One Perfect Groove • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Modjo blended disco and house into a timeless sound, defining early 2000s dance culture with smooth grooves and effortless global appeal.

item.title: Deja Vu: Familiar Grooves and the Comfort of Dance Music • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Deja Vu delivered groove-driven dance music built on familiarity, simplicity, and smooth energy, fitting clubs and late-night radio alike.

item.title: Cigarettes After Sex: Slow Motion Dreams • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Cigarettes After Sex creates slow, dreamy music built on intimacy, romance, and atmosphere, perfect for late nights and chillout radio moods.

item.title: Faithless: Meaning, Rhythm, and the Voice of the Dancefloor • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Faithless blended electronic beats with meaning and emotion, creating timeless dance music that connected listeners worldwide.

item.title: Francesca Gagnon: The Voice Between Silence and Emotion • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Francesca Gagnon is known for her intimate, emotional voice, blending cinematic soundscapes with calm, timeless beauty.

item.title: Coeur de Pirate: Fragility, Melody, and Quiet Strength • Lounge Avenue
item.description: Coeur de Pirate blends piano-led melodies and intimate vocals into calm, emotional songs perfect for late-night and chillout radio moods.

item.title: GuerriNight becomes LoungeNight • Lounge Avenue
item.description: GuerriNight becomes LoungeNight -> Every Thursday night from 10:00 PM, replays on Tuesdays at 10:00 PM, on Lounge Avenue.

item.title: What is Lounge Avenue? • Lounge Avenue
item.description: To understand what Lounge Avenue is, you first have to understand where it came from. It's not a radio that aims to grow. It aims to chill.
